player_prompt.intro:
Wo ne Player {player_id} wɔ Indian Poker agorɔ mu.
- 52-card deck; wo hu pɛn no kɔɔpo.
- Ante {ante} chip(s) ɔhaw no mu biara, {max_rounds} round(s) nyinaa.
- Nsɛm a ɛfata: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (X yɛ dodow a ɛyɛ pɔsɛtɛf biara ≤ wo chip dodow.)
- Kɔɔpo a ɛkorɔn sen biara na ɛdi nkunim wɔ pot no mu wɔ showdown.

invalid_move.ambiguous: Fa nsɛm biako pɛ a wɔde aka no, e.g. '[check]', '[bet 2]', '[call]', '[raise 3]', anaa '[fold]'.
invalid_move.amount_min: Bet / Raise amount must be ≥ 1. Ɔbɛtumi ayɛ sɛ ɔgyeɛ a, ɛsɛsɛ ne nyinaa yɛ baako.
invalid_move.cannot_bet: Nsɛm '[bet]' ntumi nni - ɛfata sɛ wo '[call]' / '[raise]' / '[fold]'.
invalid_move.nothing_to_call: Biribiara nni hɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ wofrɛ; wobɛtumi [check] mmom.
invalid_move.no_bet_to_raise: Fa [bet X] di dwuma ma w'atumi abue; wontua hwee mma no.
invalid_move.insufficient: Mfonini a enni hɔ mma saa dwumadi no.

message.showdown_tie: Showdown tie: wɔn mmienu nyinaa {card}. Pot split  obiara nya {split}.

outcome.draw: Akwan nyinaa akyi no, chips a ɛne wɔn bɔe yɛ pɛ.
